speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Master Yaxley has his brass basin out on the pole already, and a carter on the stool within.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eight days since, on the Tuesday, I went in at that door holding my cheek like an apple, and came out lighter by twelvepence and three roots.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Today I walk past his window with my mouth shut and my tongue in an empty place.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Better the gap than the drum. Keep inside the posts till the wood-cart clears the chain.
